plugins.name: wow-addon
plugins.description: World of Warcraft addon development helpers — standard-compliant scaffolding, standards compliance auditing, standards-reference refreshing (re-syncing an addon's in-repo reference and the vendored quirks catalogue as the standard evolves upstream), cross-repo learning harvesting (promoting the collection's patterns, anti-patterns, client quirks and audit findings back into the standard), pending-work triage, interface-version bumping, doc sync (including the root DEPENDENCIES.md toolchain contract), version bumping with the release-time automated-test bundle, test-battery running, consolidated automated-test recording (lint/tests/perf/complexity into frozen dated bundles), GitHub issue listing/creation plus a collection-wide issue summary (status × repo grid across every addon and upstream), git diff/commit, changeset finalization (sync-docs, commit, merge, push and branch cleanup — for the current repo or across sibling repos in dependency order), line-ending hook, and a focused WoW-specific review subagent that re-runs the out-of-game suites (lint, tests, offline perf scenarios, complexity) before it reviews.
